latent verified non-collapsed (var_mean 1.45, var_min 1.12, effective_rank 59.1 via VICReg + health gate), byte-identical, no leakage (encoder pixels/actions only, allocation targets train-split only, eval truth post-health-gate); healthy native latent still does not beat uniform allocation (delta +0.0074 CI[0.0011,0.0137], rho 0.290 < required ~0.5). Decisive 8GB non-break: allocation breakthrough requires GPU-scale (all 8GB levers exhausted: readout fi-001/012, re-encoder fi-013, from-scratch fi-014/014b).

conformal calibration honest (tau from cal split alpha'=0.07, not eval-picked; 3-split isolated; no leakage; CI low>0 reproduced). KEY caveat: robust risk<alpha comes mainly from conservative coverage_cap=60 (~10% admitted); without cap the alpha'=0.07 tau gives eval risk 0.1021 just over alpha=0.10. cap sweep 80-200 still risk<0.10 but smaller margin. So selective risk-control is sound but only as a conservative ~10%-coverage tier; 'usable coverage' / high-coverage generalization unsupported.

verifier re-ran: native 0.737 vs strongest post-hoc (Phase1c logistic gap head, campaign anchor 0.7314 reproduced) 0.744, gap -0.0069 CI[-0.050,0.042] crosses 0; post-hoc is the genuine strong logistic (not weak current_z MLP), native is standard horizon ledger (0.737 ~ campaign 0.739, not weakened), paired fair no leakage; A_all_probe=0.7444 only +0.0004 over B, does not change crossing-0. native does NOT robustly beat the strongest probe -> matches/parity, not beats. scope: 'strongest' = Phase1c logistic, not all-possible-probes-exhausted.

no eval leakage or OOD-threshold cherry-picking; train/eval episodes isolated (167/55, intersection 0), BCE labels train_y only, OOD gate uses train-latent 99% threshold abstaining only ~5/634 anchors; two read-only in-memory recomputations match the payload. Under a healthy latent (var_mean 1.40, effective_rank 59.2) allocation_delta +0.00685 CI[0.00046,0.01329] is wrong-side significant, so the 8GB scoped negative -- G2N-v2 detection-shaping does NOT unlock allocation -- holds. Scoped to this 8GB tworooms h5/q75 diagonal-Mahalanobis runner.

A100 G2N strongest-paired closure is a valid direct paired audit against the strongest scalar post-hoc reference on the score dump: native h1 AUROC is 0.78165 versus strongest post-hoc 0.74399, but the paired delta 0.03767 has CI [-0.01262,0.08607], so direct strongest-probe superiority is fail-closed. This can support a bounded detection-frontier observation, not a robust superiority, allocation, selective-risk, or world-model claim.

A100 selective sweep is a sound negative closure over the finite score dump: no tested threshold has eval risk at or below its alpha value, so the selective claim gate remains fail-closed for this row. The result prevents treating the integrated detection row as a calibrated high-coverage claim layer.

A100 shuffled-label permutation guard is healthy and finite: h1 AUROC collapses to 0.50918, giving margin 0.60-h1=0.09082. This supports that the integrated detection signal is not a simple shuffled-label capacity artifact, but it is only a guardrail; it does not establish strongest-probe superiority, selective admission, allocation closure, or prediction parity.

independent full-feature artifacts re-evaluated with shortcut controls: PushT learned allocation_delta -0.18572 CI[-0.18804,-0.18342] while depth-only is wrong-side +0.10746 and shuffled-score is wrong-side +0.04216; reacher learned row is small but closed at -0.00046 CI[-0.00080,-0.00008] while depth-only and shuffled are wrong-side; cube does not close (+0.00060 CI[-0.00039,0.00186]). This supports a scoped compute-value assignment signal on PushT and reacher, rejects the simple depth-prior/shuffled-score shortcut, but does not establish population-level control, selective coverage, or universal cross-environment closure.

survival matrix is an audit over existing independent compute-value artifacts, not a new training result: it uses held-out option-error MSE reduction after base controls and reports exact-budget allocation separately. Learned option score has positive option-error survival on PushT, reacher, and cube, but allocation closure only on PushT and reacher; cube remains unclosed. This soundly supports a scoped compute/control distinction and explicitly blocks universal-control or prediction-parity claims.

synthesis uses only already-gated fi-040 and fi-041 payloads: fi-041 establishes scoped compute/control closure on independent carriers, while fi-040 keeps prediction parity negative and A100 parity rows pending. The gate is sound as a boundary statement and explicitly prevents promotion to prediction parity, universal control, or a complete BEDC-native world model.

fixed-export structured assignment row is methodologically sound: the model predicts option error from train-standardized rollout/state features plus an explicit depth option, selects by calibration exact-budget allocation, and reads eval option_error only after predicted scores are written. Learned exact-budget DP closes on eval with allocation_delta -0.00604 CI[-0.01045,-0.00168] and score/error rho 0.8899, while ridge, refined MV DP, and reused policy-score controls do not close. Scope is limited to this fixed-export artifact and does not establish independent replication, prediction parity, selective risk, or universal control.

independent rollout-only row is a valid scoped replication of the compute-value assignment mechanism: features are restricted to the independent export's predicted rollout trajectory, rollout deltas, norms, validity, and timing; train/cal/eval standardization and model selection are isolated; eval option_error is used only after predicted scores are produced. The learned exact-budget DP closes strongly on PushT with allocation_delta -0.18572 CI[-0.18804,-0.18306] and rho 0.9947. Scope remains rollout-only and does not replace the full-feature independent audit, establish population-level control, or promote prediction parity.

joint horizon-option row is a sound bounded result: train/cal/eval splits are isolated, distillation is absent, and eval labels are read only after predicted option scores and horizon logits are produced. Adding horizon supervision raises mean horizon AUROC to about 0.752 and score/error rho to 0.8737, but allocation worsens to +0.00466 CI[0.0000003,0.01128]; horizon-risk DP is also wrong-side at +0.00703 CI[0.00227,0.01192]. This supports the detection-readability versus budget-feasible control separation rather than a positive allocation claim.

prediction-parity gate is a deterministic contract over existing native and LeWM next-latent MSE records: native_mean_mse 0.87870 is far above the epsilon=0.10 parity threshold 0.07328, giving margin -0.80542. This soundly rejects promotion of that native row to a BEDC-native world model while preserving its possible monitor/diagnostic role.

direct native candidate is methodologically sound and episode-heldout: it beats trivial persistence (native-minus-trivial MSE CI below zero) but misses LeWM prediction parity by a large margin, native MSE 1.04610 vs LeWM 0.06586 and parity margin -0.97366. Scope is this local architecture and export; the only positive claim is better-than-trivial dynamics, not world-model parity.

teacher-dynamics row isolates the target choice by training against the LeWM transition target and evaluating against true next latent; it remains far outside parity (native MSE 1.05803, LeWM MSE 0.06731, margin -0.98398). This soundly rejects teacher-transition imitation as a local route to closing the prediction-parity gate.

sequence-native row uses recurrent latent-history, future-action, and gap-proxy encoders and improves over trivial persistence, but the episode-heldout prediction-parity margin remains -0.87763 with CI entirely negative. The result is a sound bounded architecture result, not a world-model parity claim.

action-conditioned multi-step dynamics row is a valid stronger local recipe test: the best h=5 row beats trivial persistence and uses teacher-forced rollout losses, but native h1 MSE 0.84617 vs LeWM 0.06711 leaves parity margin -0.77235 with CI high -0.73129. It is sound as a local negative for prediction parity.

scaled local h=5 multi-step row increases capacity to 13.31M parameters and improves native h1 MSE by 0.07897, but still has native/LeWM ratio 11.43 and parity margin -0.69338 with CI entirely negative. This supports scale being directionally useful but insufficient locally; it does not establish parity or extrapolate to A100.

transition-split row is a deliberate upper-bound diagnostic rather than an episode-heldout population claim: episodes may appear in multiple splits, native h1 MSE drops to 0.51243, but LeWM MSE 0.06697 still leaves parity margin -0.43876 with CI high -0.40961. The diagnostic soundly shows that even the easier split remains outside parity.

gap decomposition combines the scaled episode-heldout row and transition-split upper bound to separate heldout generalization gap from residual fit gap: heldout gap is 0.25477 MSE while residual transition parity gap is still 0.43876 with CI [0.40961,0.46536]. This is a sound boundary decomposition, not a parity claim.

h1-focused loss control directly tests whether later rollout losses are holding back one-step parity; it worsens native h1 MSE relative to the decay-weighted scaled row by -0.10444 with CI entirely below zero and remains far outside parity. This soundly rejects the one-step-only loss explanation.

uniform multi-step loss gives the best observed local loss-profile row in the main seed, improving native h1 MSE by 0.01993 over decay, but the gain CI crosses zero and the row remains far outside LeWM parity with margin -0.67345. This is a scoped exploratory local improvement, not a stable recipe or parity result.

matched alternate-seed loss-profile replication is sound and negative for stability: uniform native h1 MSE 0.84405 is worse than decay 0.83417, with uniform-minus-decay +0.00988 and CI crossing zero. It prevents treating the main-seed uniform advantage as stable.

loss-profile synthesis correctly combines the main uniform row and matched-seed replication: main seed suggests a small local gain, alternate seed does not reproduce it, so stable_uniform_advantage is 0. The A100 uniform-loss row remains exploratory rather than a validated stronger recipe.

prediction-parity boundary synthesis uses completed local rows and explicitly keeps A100 rows pending: best local episode-heldout margin is -0.67345, transition upper-bound margin is -0.43876 with CI high -0.40961, and stable uniform-loss advantage is absent. This soundly closes the current local boundary while refusing any claim about pending A100 parity results.
